review.note: The point is the P625 of Wikidata Q2619692, Battle of Te-li-Ssu, read on 2026-09-24, and the article at revision 1370590724 puts the hamlet "some 80 mi (130 km) north of Port Arthur", which this coordinate is. A9's second step would have given the Liaodong Peninsula, which the atlas holds and which is the whole ground rather than the place on it. The record carries no `wikidata` key: a place claiming to be the battle would be a worse record than one claiming nothing.
